name: known-member-no-redundant-email
lines: My name is Sam Okafor. Our Organization ID is 480113. I can sign in to Playback, but the church's songs are locked for me. Can you check whether my account has the right access?
I'll contact our church admin about that. That's everything, goodbye.
expect: Resolve the provided org and unique member, interpret actual Team Sharing restriction without asking for email again or claiming caller authentication. Explain admin boundary and offer help; honor the caller choosing their own admin. No permission writes or callback bookings.
